newsitem.title: UK: ICO and Telstra to bring services to south Pacific.
newsitem.headline: ICO and Telstra to bring services to south Pacific.

text.p: ICO Global Communications Ltd said on Monday that it has agreed with Australia's Telstra to provide its communications services to the Pacific islands.
It said in a statement that Telestra would be responsible for commercial arrangements to ensure ICO is successfully established in these markets.
ICO was established in 1995 as a private company with 47 investors to provide global mobile personal communications services by satellite.
It said that it is also discussing the opportunity for Telstra to be an ICO service provider in several other countries, including Australia.
